text:
laura: Quick heads-up: I opened a compact docs PR that proposes a small docs-lint rule and adds a short migration appendix for structured outputs + a minimal SDK snippet. https://github.com/redwood/docs/pull/1723 — can reviewers scan for wording and link targets?
ci-bot: preview build queued :hourglass: https://deploy.preview/redwood/docs/pr-1723
omar: Skimming now. One thing: snippet uses `resp.output_schema` in examples but our public SDK uses `resp.schema`. We should standardize to `resp.schema` everywhere.
laura: Good catch, fixing that. Also proposing a docs-lint rule that flags `type: ["x","null"]` and suggests `anyOf` instead — saves readers from validator quirks.
anya: Strong +1 for the linter. Can we include a one-line example of the suggested replacement next to the warning? e.g. `items: { anyOf: [{type: 'string'}, {type: 'null'}] }`
felix: Also add a tiny streaming fallback in the JS snippet. A 2-line branch so readers know how to handle chunked tool responses: ```js
const r = await client.call(...);
if (r.stream) for await (const c of r.stream) handle(c);
```
omar: Minor link note: there are a couple of anchors pointing to /docs/function-calling which redirect; better to link to /docs/tool-calling directly to keep anchors intact.
laura: Thanks — I'll update to /docs/tool-calling and add the streaming fallback and the anyOf example. Any objections to the linter proposal?
anya: No objections. I can prototype a docs-lint rule in a follow-up PR that returns a markdown hint with the replacement snippet.
felix: From product POV, maybe add one sentence on when to prefer compact schema vs full JSON Schema (tradeoffs: token cost vs strict contract). Helps teams choose during migration.
laura: Will add a short decision sentence in the migration appendix.
ci-bot: preview ready :white_check_mark: https://deploy.preview/redwood/docs/pr-1723?v=2
laura: Pushed the fixups (schema name, streaming note, anyOf examples, link targets). If nothing else I will merge in ~10m. Please push any micro-edits to the branch if needed.
omar: Pushed a tiny wording tweak for the anyOf paragraph. No ML blockers.
anya: I'll follow up with the linter prototype PR and link it in the PR description.
laura: Thanks everyone — merging shortly if CI stays green.
